subject.title: fix(ollama): resolve web search secret refs

question: Should Ollama web search intentionally fail closed when `models.providers.ollama.apiKey` is an unavailable SecretRef even if `OLLAMA_API_KEY` exists, and should the four optional policy hooks become part of the exported provider web-search helper?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and proven, but it deliberately changes fallback behavior for existing configurations and expands a public plugin SDK contract; those are ownership decisions rather than unresolved code defects.

options.title: Adopt shared fail-closed policy
options.body: Land the additive SDK hooks and block ambient fallback for unavailable configured refs, preserving the tested diagnostics and explicit credential-selection semantics.

options.title: Preserve ambient compatibility
options.body: Revise the helper or Ollama integration so unavailable configured refs may still fall back to `OLLAMA_API_KEY`, accepting that a different credential can be selected than the one configured.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared fail-closed policy
recommendation.body: Land the additive SDK hooks and block ambient fallback for unavailable configured refs, preserving the tested diagnostics and explicit credential-selection semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced both the current Ollama path and the shared SecretRef policy, providing the strongest history signal for this compatibility and SDK decision.
